method: Replaced v1 proxies with feature-bearing body passages or exact heading/markup locators. Visual observations remain accepted parent-reading provenance.

recommendations: Use only literal body or MathML evidence at the cited locator.
Keep metadata, footnotes, annotations, enclosures and later printed witnesses in their source layers; omit them from user body export unless policy permits.
Represent unresolved raw diag/ramme, damaged markers, missing enclosures and disputed printed prose as holds; do not invent cleanup text.
